person.persName: عبد الحق بن محمد بن عثمان بن مرين المريني
عبد الحق بن محمد بن عثمان

relation.desc: عثمان (وقال غيره انه ابن عثمان بن أحمد كما مضى)
relation.note: The corpus preserves two conflicting nasab versions (b. Muḥammad b. ʿUthmān b. Marīn / b. ʿUthmān b. Aḥmad) without deciding between them. Per editorial decision (Waka, 2026-08-11; 要判断B39-43 §D-9), the second version is adopted with cert=low, as it matches the historical father of the Marinid sultan ʿAbd al-Ḥaqq II (r. 823–869), Abū Saʿīd ʿUthmān III (wd:Q2688156, item verified); no corpus entry for the father exists, so provisional TMP-P-000729 is assigned. The variant genealogy remains in full in the prose translations.

state.label: صاحب فاس وما والاها من المغرب
ṣāḥib Fās wa-mā wālā-hā min al-Maghrib

person.note: フェズおよびマグリブのその周辺地域の支配者（サーヒブ）であるアブドゥルハック・ビン・ムハンマド・ビン・ウスマーン・ビン・マリーン・アル＝マリーニー。このように彼を系譜づける者もいるが、別の者は、前述の通り、彼をウスマーン・ビン・アフマドの息子であるとした。

ʿAbd al-Ḥaqq bin Muḥammad bin ʿUthmān bin Marīn al-Marīnī, the ruler of Fez and its surrounding regions in the Maghrib. Thus I saw some lineage-makers trace his ancestry, while others said that he was the son of ʿUthmān bin Aḥmad, as mentioned previously.
